name: Pacific Whale Foundation Eco-Adventures
summary: Small-group whale watching and wildlife cruises from Urangan Harbour in Hervey Bay on Ocean Defender, a 12 metre rigid inflatable boat. The operator is a registered Australian charity and the Australian arm of the Pacific Whale Foundation, and it puts its tour profits into whale research, education and conservation. Whale watches run through the humpback season from July to October, with a wildlife cruise through the Great Sandy Strait in summer.
standouts: Advanced Ecotourism certified through Ecotourism Australia
Hervey Bay's Ultimate Small Group Whale Watch is a Tourism Australia Signature Experience
Registered Australian charity; tour and shop profits go to research, education and conservation
Working in Hervey Bay since 1984, with whale research behind its tours

trips.title: Hervey Bay's Ultimate Small Group Whale Watch
trips.summary: A three hour small-group whale watch from Urangan Harbour on Ocean Defender, a 12 metre rigid inflatable boat with covered, forward-facing seats at water level. Crew trained in marine sciences give commentary, and underwater hydrophones let guests hear whale song. Children receive a Junior Naturalist activity booklet.
highlights: Small group on Ocean Defender, a purpose-built 12 metre rigid inflatable boat
Live whale song through underwater hydrophones
Commentary from crew trained in marine sciences, with an onboard whale researcher collecting data
Junior Naturalist programme and activity booklet for children

bring: Camera (underwater and GoPro cameras are allowed, drones are not)

trips.title: Hervey Bay's Sunset Whale Watch
trips.summary: A whale watch of about 2.5 hours on Ocean Defender, timed for sunset over the Great Sandy Strait. Guests hear whale song through underwater hydrophones and learn about the latest whale research from the crew. The trip is limited to 30 passengers, and guests may bring their own alcohol within set limits.

trips.title: Seven Island Ultimate Wildlife Cruise
trips.summary: A 2.5 hour cruise through the sheltered Great Sandy Strait between the Fraser Coast and K'gari, passing Round Island, Little Woody Island, Duck Island, Picnic Island and Big Woody Island. Certified naturalists talk about the wildlife, the habitats and Pacific Whale Foundation's research. It is listed as a summer cruise.
highlights: Route through the Great Sandy Strait past several small islands and Pelican Bank
Wildlife recorded on the route includes dolphins, green turtles, dugongs, rays and sea eagles

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private hire of Ocean Defender for school, education, naturalist, photography and community fundraising groups, as well as celebrations and corporate outings. Packages are tailored to the group, with discounted rates for school, charity and education groups. Quotes are by email, phone or the online form.
